headline: Net profit falls from last year
summary_short: Net profit was KRW 490.5B, down 26.6% y/y, and nine-month net profit was KRW 1.96T, down 3.2% y/y. Return on equity was 23.5%.
summary_long: Third-party coverage reports subsidiary net profit of KRW 328.5B at the insurer (-29.2%) and KRW 206.4B at the securities arm (+3.2%). One summary lists operating profit of KRW 519.9B on revenue of KRW 13.13T. Yahoo EPS was KRW 2,868. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage (Yonhap and a filing summary); the net profit basis (total vs owners) was not confirmed. EPS is Yahoo data.
